Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes Moves Gateway filesystem preparation and recurring inspections into asynchronous operations and existing workers while preserving ordering and cleanup ownership. **Example:** The reported Linux/btrfs workload used a 35 GiB agent database, about 5,000 sessions, and 62,000 workspace files. - **Before:** The measured baseline performed 39,322 selected main-thread filesystem syscalls per minute. - **After:** Candidate source 097dad72 performed 62; this measurement is explicitly pinned to that earlier source. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | Useful, supported by shipped-entry-point and upgrade evidence, with no new actionable finding in the inspected scope; exact-head CI remains pending. | | **Proof confidence** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | Sufficient (live_output): Supplied evidence exercises packaged Gateway filesystem behavior on 097dad72 and fresh/stable-upgrade/startup flows on 4b4f6e81, with later changed-owner qualifications; the reviewed successor changes only a browser test and does not relabel those earlier executions. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Performance · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Slow host filesystem operations can pause unrelated Gateway requests and timers. **Reason:** The measured reduction addresses the stated responsiveness problem, and the maintainer-authored PR explicitly records the adverse resource costs and remaining coverage limits. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep open: this PR addresses a concrete Gateway responsiveness problem that remains on main. The inspected repairs and test-only successor introduce no identified blocker; current-head CI is still running. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `d22df936d67764d6ec6cb1e1c6c015651f8d853f` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Gateway requests and timers prepare session, workspace, credential, and process facts; existing workers perform necessary I/O and return results to the owning runtime. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Gateway requests and timers] --> B[Runtime owners] B --> C[Async preparation] C --> D[Existing workers] D --> E[Filesystem and databases] D --> F[Results and settlement] F --> B ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep necessary filesystem work with existing asynchronous owners while retaining physical identity, FIFO ordering, and accepted-work settlement. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Fetched main contains synchronous filesystem operations in affected Gateway paths, and the supplied packaged workload quantifies their removal on its pinned candidate; no target code was executed during this review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The inspected changes follow the existing-owner approach: remove redundant work, carry prepared facts, and move required I/O while preserving native authority and settlement contracts. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [81ca4f4d712a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/81ca4f4d712a67c012c7dc0311e0fa37ac576490). ### Provenance checked - `SQLite admission and committed publication` keeps the original intent (da67a08b20eb3c16445c7d4cc469f96751736cf9: Keep committed facts recoverable and avoid replaying acknowledged mutations when publication fails, as documented in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167570.) - `Session discovery reuse` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (f0c671ec92a5370b43e610c8501681202e34805c: Reuse immutable discovery results while preserving physical replacement, registry invalidation, and scoped authority checks.) - `Adopted-process identity uncertainty` keeps the original intent (36b62fc7d262e5e7b90221b59fad6d4933048aa1: Keep live commands tracked when identity inspection fails and refuse unverified destructive signaling.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Exact successor is test-only:** The difference from the previous reviewed head changes only the typed character and matching redo expectation; draft replacement, focus, composition, and history assertions remain. ([`ui/src/pages/new-session/composer-editor.browser.test.ts:25`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d22df936d67764d6ec6cb1e1c6c015651f8d853f/ui/src/pages/new-session/composer-editor.browser.test.ts#L25), [d22df936d677](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d22df936d67764d6ec6cb1e1c6c015651f8d853f)) - **Current main retains the affected synchronous path:** Cold agent writer admission on fetched main still reads physical identity synchronously; the PR separates asynchronous discovery from writer reservation. ([`src/state/openclaw-agent-write-admission.ts`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/81ca4f4d712a67c012c7dc0311e0fa37ac576490/src/state/openclaw-agent-write-admission.ts), [81ca4f4d712a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/81ca4f4d712a67c012c7dc0311e0fa37ac576490)) - **Prior allowlist finding is resolved:** The provider identity distinguishes open allowlists from restrictive exclusions, and the held-rebuild regression checks immediate removal and restoration. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/chat-metadata-model-list.ts:81`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d22df936d67764d6ec6cb1e1c6c015651f8d853f/src/gateway/server-methods/chat-metadata-model-list.ts#L81), [d22df936d677](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d22df936d67764d6ec6cb1e1c6c015651f8d853f)) - **Runtime and compatibility evidence:** The body and discussion distinguish packaged Gateway measurements on 097dad72 from fresh-install, latest-stable upgrade, and historical Projects startup proof on 4b4f6e81, with preservation assertions and later source bridges; https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197510#issuecomment-6891562433 records the upgrade results. ([`scripts/e2e/lib/upgrade-survivor/project-worktree-startup.mjs`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d22df936d67764d6ec6cb1e1c6c015651f8d853f/scripts/e2e/lib/upgrade-survivor/project-worktree-startup.mjs), [d22df936d677](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d22df936d67764d6ec6cb1e1c6c015651f8d853f)) - **Owner-recorded performance tradeoffs:** The maintainer-authored body explicitly retains increased CPU, allocation, bootstrap latency, and cleanup costs in exchange for reducing main-thread filesystem exposure; it makes no final-tree performance-equivalence claim. ([d22df936d677](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d22df936d67764d6ec6cb1e1c6c015651f8d853f)) - **Actual dependency protocol inspected:** The changed Codex adapter implements the dependency's process/write protocol; direct sibling-source inspection confirms base64 stdin writes and the pipeStdin requirement. ([`codex-rs/exec-server/README.md:337`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/6aaac694803004a63c6f393d153c96d22521a6b9/codex-rs/exec-server/README.md#L337), [6aaac6948030](https://github.com/openai/codex/commit/6aaac694803004a63c6f393d153c96d22521a6b9)) ### PR surface PR surface statistics unavailable: the file list is incomplete. ### Preflight source Source unknown. Source comparison at the observed PR snapshot only. Completion is self-reported; body, policy, tests, execution, and report bytes are not verified. ### Labels Label changes: - add `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`: ClawSweeper has no concrete contributor-facing blocker left for this PR. Label justifications: - `P2`: Reduces Gateway-wide exposure to filesystem stalls without evidence requiring emergency prioritization. - `merge-risk: 🚨 compatibility`: The plugin-visible sandbox execution contract gains optional asynchronous preparation; the owner-authored documentation and bundled consumers describe and implement the additive contract. - `rating: 🐚 platinum hermit`: Overall readiness is 🐚 platinum hermit; proof is 🐚 platinum hermit and patch quality is 🐚 platinum hermit. - `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`: ClawSweeper has no concrete contributor-facing blocker left for this PR. - `proof: sufficient`: Contributor real behavior proof is sufficient. ### Rating scale 6/6 🦀 challenger crab · 5/6 🦞 diamond lobster · 4/6 🐚 platinum hermit · 3/6 🦐 gold shrimp · 2/6 🦪 silver shellfish · 1/6 🧂 unranked krab.
